title: Block Drop
author: cobanov
description: Falling-block puzzle with chunky 3D pieces, wall kicks, hold and T-spins. Play endless Marathon, race 40 lines in Sprint or dig out 10 rows of garbage in Dig.

controls.A: Rotate clockwise; pick a menu entry; play again
controls.B: Rotate counter-clockwise; back in menus, resume; title from the results
